## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue and this branch contains only that work.
- [ ] This PR has relevant topic labels and no issue Kanban status labels; linked issue statuses are current.
- [ ] Affected documentation and examples agree on the proposed meaning.
- [ ] Evidence is distinguished from proposals and unimplemented capabilities.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic or have permission for publication; no sensitive data is included.
- [ ] Applicable licences and third-party attribution are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant checks from [Contributing](https://github.com/injectionator/n8r-surface/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks-before-a-pull-request) ran and their results are recorded above.
- [ ] Human verification steps were rehearsed; actual evidence and unproved outcomes are recorded.
- [ ] This PR is draft until review readiness is authorized; merge and release are separate decisions.
